data.completion_memo: Follow-up fix: the filter panel closed whenever the Chat updated, so it could not be used while the agent was running. Cause: the control registered `window.addEventListener("scroll", reposition, true)` with capture, so the transcript's own auto-scroll during a Run (scroll events do not bubble but are observed in the capture phase at window) dismissed the panel. Removed the scroll listener entirely; the trigger lives in the fixed header, so normal transcript scrolling must not dismiss it. The resize listener now re-anchors the portal (recomputes placement from the trigger and popup rects via fitMenuToViewport) instead of closing. Closure behavior is unchanged for outside pointerdown and Escape. Added a regression test to ChatOutputFilterControl.test.tsx that opens the panel and dispatches window/document scroll events, asserting it stays open. Verified: `pnpm check` clean, ChatOutputFilterControl.test.tsx (3) passes, and the whole pnpm test:chat suite (46 files, 297 tests) passes.

lines:
Feature: a filter icon button at the top of the Chat opens a dropdown with a checkbox per entry — `thinking` and `tools`. Unchecked entries are not displayed; toggling must update already-rendered content; with both unchecked only user input and model output remain.
Implementation notes (researched): render pipeline is `timelineItems` (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:241-244`, must stay unfiltered for the question dialog / Run Details at 932) → `feedItems` (245) → `ConversationTimeline` → `presentTimelineItems` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:65). Classification: standalone reasoning is `kind==="thinking"` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:499); tool/MCP are `kind==="tool"` (523) / `kind==="mcp"` (generic card). Crucially a model-call span with streamed reasoning is rendered by `ModelCallBlock` (255) which contains the reasoning bubble *and* the final assistant answer, so a naive `kind` filter would delete the answer — thread a `hideThinking` prop into `ModelCallBlock` instead and hide only its reasoning bubble. Add the control to `.run-actions` in the Chat header (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:715`), reusing the `TodoControl` popover pattern (outside-click/Escape close, aria-expanded/controls). No production localStorage exists, so keep the filter in React state (session-scoped).
Verification: extend `ModelCallBlock.test.tsx` / timeline tests for hiding thinking inside a model call and hiding tool rows, and assert the user message + assistant answer remain.

data.title: Add a Chat output filter for reasoning (thinking) and tool entries
